blocking_issues.location_en: Section 'The labor market is changing, but the transition is uneven' and its labor-force participation chart.
blocking_issues.location_pt_BR: Seção 'O mercado de trabalho está mudando, mas a transição é desigual' e seu gráfico de participação na força de trabalho.
blocking_issues.issue: The dossier makes labor-market change and female participation a central social transmission mechanism but anchors the section and its labor chart to Q2 2025. GASTAT published Labor Market Statistics for Q1 2026 on June 30, 2026. Disclosing that the older data are not a September snapshot avoids a false current-date label but does not satisfy the country-dossier requirement to re-verify a material current mechanism when a newer official observation exists.
evidence: GASTAT Labor Market Statistics Q1 2026 publication record, June 30, 2026: https://www.stats.gov.sa/en/search?delta=60&page=38&sort=createDate-&start=30
GASTAT Q2 2025 release currently cited: https://www.stats.gov.sa/en/w/news/93

required_fixes: Update the labor section and chart in EN and PT-BR using the latest comparable official Q1 2026 observations, including period labels and material changes in Saudi/female participation or unemployment.
If Q2 2025 is retained for longitudinal comparison, add Q1 2026 and explain any comparability caveat.
Reassess directional claims about progress and segmentation against the newer observation.
Keep EN/PT-BR values, units, periods and interpretation semantically identical.

country_context_contract.summary: Valid v2 Saudi country dossier with country geography and materially related canonical Global Macro IDs.

taxonomy.summary: global-system-power, related political-economy-markets, all three dimensions, topics and controlled phenomena are substantively supported.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Direct thesis opening, finding-led headings, coherent institutional-to-economic-to-social progression, no exposed QA/template structure; PT-BR is substantially localized.

contextual_depth.summary: Political implementation, hydrocarbon fiscal dependence, PIF allocation, labor reform and household incidence are connected through mechanisms.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Visual floor and bilingual structure pass, but the central labor chart uses Q2 2025 despite a newer Q1 2026 official release.

translation.summary: EN/PT-BR preserve the same thesis and mechanisms; labor refresh must be symmetric.

contrary_evidence: GASTAT has a newer Q1 2026 labor-market release than the Q2 2025 observation used as the dossier's sole labor quantitative anchor.
limitations: IMF 2026 macro values are projections under conflict/shipping uncertainty and are identified as such.
The export map is schematic and does not claim current throughput or precise pipeline geometry.
PIF strategy statements are institutional objectives, not proof of realized productivity; the dossier frames outcomes as tests.
